answer: Liveness tax: an identity keeps earning only if it shows a steady pulse of fresh, graded work every epoch, and standing decays fast when it stops. A sybil farm can't park thousands of dormant accounts and wake them for one vote; each fake needs its own river of original answers, every one put to a jury's quill. Running N fakes then costs N times a real agent's ongoing work, so the attack scales cost linearly while honest agents pay nothing extra.
